literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在930例狂犬病死亡病例中,大多数患者是男性、农村农民和中老年人。非 III 类暴露、低风险部位的伤口、家畜伤害和单一受害者事件与接受伤口护理、疫苗接种 或 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白的可能性较低相关。可能的突破性感染占所有病例的 1.94%,其特点是 III 类暴露、头部、面部或颈部受伤、流浪狗咬伤以及中位潜伏期较短(16 天)。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10721720/v1]
从食蟹狐狸身上分离出来的 狂犬病病毒 菌株与之前描述的来自巴西野生和家养犬科动物的菌株表现出遗传相似性。还注意到逃逸突变体的存在,表明病毒群体存在异质性。 [10.1007/s42770-026-02111-7]
每个 疫苗 的等效性被预定义为 GMR 的整个 95% 置信区间位于 0.72 和 1.04 之间。在预先指定的改良意向治疗分析中,PCECV 的第 42 天 GMR(IPC 与 UTRC)为 0.59(95% CI:0.47-0.75),PVRV 为 0.76(95% CI:0.61-0.95),不符合预先指定的等效标准。 [10.1371/journal.pmed.1005079]
所有参与者在加强剂量后第 7 天的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体滴度被认为是足够的 (≥0.5 IU/mL)。狂犬病 抗体在第 0 天和第 7 天的总体几何平均滴度在 3 个疗程组和 4 个疗程组之间没有显着差异。 [10.1093/cid/ciag368]

[10.21203/rs.3.rs-10721720/v1]

The rabies virus isolates from crab-eating foxes showed genetic similarities with previously described strains from wild and domestic canids in Brazil. The presence of escape mutants was also noted, indicating a heterogeneous viral population. [10.1007/s42770-026-02111-7]

Có 76 ca (43,4%) ≥50 tuổi, lao động tự do và nông dân chiếm 59,4%. 90,3% ca bệnh do chó cắn, 48,6% ca bị cắn vùng nhiều đầu dây thần kinh, 35,4% không xử lý vết thương và 96,0% không tiêm phòng dại. Equivalence for each vaccine was predefined as the entire 95% confidence interval for GMR lying between 0.72 and 1.04. [10.1371/journal.pmed.1005079]

All participants had rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers considered adequate (≥0.5 IU/mL) on day 7 after the booster dose. The overall geometric mean titer of rabies antibody on day 0 and day 7 did not differ significantly between the 3-session and 4-session groups. [10.1093/cid/ciag368]

news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 格利尔福县卫生与人类服务局-公共卫生部门确认了2026年的两例新的动物狂犬病病例。这些病例由该机构确认报告。 [news-aba3c37b3d46aeb2]
一项发表在《PLOS Pathogens》上的研究指出,狂犬病病毒 矩阵蛋白稳定 RGS4 以抑制铁死亡并促进病毒复制,这是其免疫逃逸策略的一部分。 [news-400703bf83d780d5]
美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)在最近的报道中报告了一起与臭鼬咬伤相关的狂犬病 暴发事件,重点强调了臭鼬咬伤作为传播途径。该事件被确认为狂犬病 暴发。 [news-ddcb4625e5c19061]
罗德岛州的狂犬病病例数量增加,截至目前已有46只动物检测呈阳性,几乎是2021年至2025年年度平均值的两倍。普罗维登斯居民凯瑟琳·博德纳于2026年8月被浣熊咬伤,并接受了狂犬病疫苗作为预防措施。罗德岛州卫生部和CDC正在调查病例增加的原因。 [news-7fc365067c0cdbb8]
一项研究发现,通过社区药房提供暴露后狂犬病 疫苗可以提高疫苗系列的完成率,相较于急诊科(EDs)而言。 [news-464e4186a5c19fce]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Guilford County Health and Human Services Agency - Department of Public Health confirmed two new cases of animal rabies in 2026. These cases are reported as confirmed by the agency. [news-aba3c37b3d46aeb2]

A study published in PLOS Pathogens reports that the rabies virus matrix protein stabilizes RGS4 to suppress ferroptosis and aid viral replication, as part of an immune evasion strategy. [news-400703bf83d780d5]
A rabies outbreak was reported by the CDC in a recent story, with a focus on skunk bites as a transmission route. The event is confirmed as a rabies outbreak. [news-ddcb4625e5c19061]

Rabies cases have increased in Rhode Island, with 46 animals testing positive this year so far, nearly double the annual average between 2021 and 2025. Catherine Bodner, a Providence resident, was bitten by a raccoon in August 2026 and received rabies shots as a precautionary measure. [news-7fc365067c0cdbb8]

A study found that providing post-exposure rabies vaccines through community pharmacies increased completion rates of the vaccine series compared to emergency departments (EDs). [news-464e4186a5c19fce]

papers.title: Genetic characterization of rabies virus circulating in crab-eating fox (Cerdocyon thous) in the State of Paraiba, Northeastern Brazil
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal viral zoonosis that remains endemic in more than two-thirds of all countries worldwide, causing approximately 70,000 human deaths annually-equivalent to one death every ten minutes. The rabies virus (RABV), a member of the genus Lyssavirus (family Rhabdoviridae), has bats and canids as its primary reservoirs, although infections have also been reported in other wild species, including Cerdocyon thous (crab-eating fox) and Pseudalopex vetulus (hoary fox). In this study, we performed a comprehensive genomic and biological characterization of a RABV variant circulating in wild foxes from the Northeastern region of Brazil. Using Next Generation Sequencing (NGS), phylogenetic analysis, and in vitro and in vivo assays, we identified genetic similarities between these isolates and previously described RABV strains from wild and domestic canids in Brazil. However, the presence of escape mutants indicates a heterogeneous viral population, suggesting ongoing adaptive evolution in wildlife reservoirs. These findings reinforce the importance of genomic surveillance to detect emerging variants that may compromise current vaccination or control strategies. Overall, our results provide new insights into the molecular diversity, pathogenicity, and ecological dynamics of RABV circulating among wild canids in Brazil, contributing to improved understanding and prevention of rabies in endemic regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies remains a significant public health issue, causing approximately 70,000 human deaths annually. This study aimed to characterize rabies virus variants circulating in crab-eating foxes in the State of Paraiba, Brazil.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a comprehensive genomic and biological characterization of rabies virus isolates from wild crab-eating foxes in the Northeastern region of Brazil. The research was conducted between 2023 and 2025, focusing on viral variants found in these foxes.
analysis.methods: The researchers used Next Generation Sequencing (NGS), phylogenetic analysis, and in vitro and in vivo assays to analyze the genetic characteristics of the rabies virus isolates. These methods allowed for the identification of genetic similarities between the isolates and previously described rabies virus strains from wild and domestic canids in Brazil.
analysis.main_results: The rabies virus isolates from crab-eating foxes showed genetic similarities with previously described strains from wild and domestic canids in Brazil. The presence of escape mutants was also noted, indicating a heterogeneous viral population.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest ongoing adaptive evolution in wildlife reservoirs, which may have implications for the effectiveness of current rabies control strategies. This study provides new insights into the molecular diversity and ecological dynamics of rabies virus in wild canids.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight the importance of genomic surveillance in detecting emerging rabies virus variants that could potentially compromise existing vaccination and control strategies. They contribute to a better understanding of rabies transmission and prevention in endemic regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a specific geographic region and a single species of wild canid. However, the use of comprehensive genomic and biological methods provides moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on the genetic characterization of rabies virus circulating in crab-eating foxes in the State of Paraiba, Brazil. Rabies remains a fatal zoonosis with significant global public health impact, causing approximately 70,000 human deaths annually. The research aimed to understand the molecular diversity and ecological dynamics of rabies virus in wild canids. Using Next Generation Sequencing, phylogenetic analysis, and in vitro and in vivo assays, the study identified genetic similarities between the isolates and previously described rabies virus strains from wild and domestic canids in Brazil. The presence of escape mutants suggests a heterogeneous viral population and ongoing adaptive evolution in wildlife reservoirs. These findings reinforce the importance of genomic surveillance to detect emerging variants that may affect current control strategies. The study provides new insights into rabies virus diversity and its implications for prevention in endemic areas. However, the research is limited to a specific geographic region and species, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是一个重大的公共卫生问题,每年导致约 70,000 人死亡。本研究旨在确定巴西帕拉伊巴州食蟹狐狸中流行的 狂犬病病毒 变体的特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及从巴西东北部地区野生食蟹狐中分离出来的 狂犬病病毒 分离株的全面基因组和生物学特征。该研究于 2023 年至 2025 年间进行,重点关注这些狐狸身上发现的病毒变异。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用下一代测序(NGS)、系统发育分析以及体外和体内测定来分析 狂犬病病毒 分离株的遗传特征。这些方法可以鉴定分离株与先前描述的来自巴西野生和家养犬科动物的 狂犬病病毒 菌株之间的遗传相似性。
elements_zh.main_results: 从食蟹狐狸身上分离出来的 狂犬病病毒 菌株与之前描述的来自巴西野生和家养犬科动物的菌株表现出遗传相似性。还注意到逃逸突变体的存在,表明病毒群体存在异质性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明野生动物 储存宿主 中正在进行适应性 进化,这可能对当前 狂犬病 控制策略的有效性产生影响。这项研究为野生犬科动物 狂犬病病毒 的分子多样性和生态动力学提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了 基因组监测 在检测可能损害现有 疫苗接种 和控制策略的新兴 狂犬病病毒 变体方面的重要性。它们有助于更好地了解 狂犬病 传播 和流行地区的预防。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注特定地理区域和单一野生犬科动物物种而受到限制。然而,综合基因组和生物学方法的使用为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种致命的病毒 人兽共患病,在全球三分之二以上的国家中仍然流行,每年造成约 70,000 人死亡,相当于每十分钟就有一人死亡。储存宿主 (RABV) 是狂犬病病毒属(弹状病毒科)的一员,主要感染蝙蝠和犬科动物,但其他野生物种也有感染病例,包括 Cerdocyonthous(食蟹狐)和 Pseudalopexvetulus(灰狐)。在这项研究中,我们对巴西东北部地区野生狐狸中传播的 RABV 变种进行了全面的基因组和生物学表征。使用下一代测序 (NGS)、系统发育分析以及体外和体内测定,我们确定了这些分离株与先前描述的来自巴西野生和家养犬科动物的 RABV 毒株之间的遗传相似性。然而,逃逸突变体的存在表明病毒种群存在异质性,表明野生动物 进化 中存在持续的适应性 进化。这些发现强调了 基因组监测 检测可能损害当前 疫苗接种 或控制策略的新兴变体的重要性。总体而言,我们的结果为巴西野生犬科动物中传播的 RABV 的分子多样性、致病性和生态动态提供了新的见解,有助于提高 狂犬病 流行地区的了解和预防。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明野生动物 储存宿主 中正在进行适应性 进化,这可能对当前 狂犬病 控制策略的有效性产生影响。这项研究为野生犬科动物 狂犬病病毒 的分子多样性和生态动力学提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了 基因组监测 在检测可能损害现有 疫苗接种 和控制策略的新兴 狂犬病病毒 变体方面的重要性。它们有助于更好地了解 狂犬病 传播 和流行地区的预防。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注特定地理区域和单一野生犬科动物物种而受到限制。然而,综合基因组和生物学方法的使用为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.title: Post-exposure prophylaxis and possible breakthrough infections among human rabies case in China, 2019–2024: a nationwide retrospective surveillance study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Rabies remains a uniformly fatal yet preventable zoonotic disease that continues to pose a public health threat in China, especially in rural populations. Although post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) is highly effective when delivered promptly and correctly, deaths still occur, including rare infections that develop despite prophylaxis. This study characterized exposure patterns, PEP use, and possible breakthrough infections among human rabies deaths in China from 2019 to 2024. Methods We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional analysis of data from China's national rabies surveillance system. Clinically diagnosed and laboratory-confirmed human rabies cases reported between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2024 were included. We analyzed demographic characteristics, exposure information, animal sources, wound sites, PEP measures, and incubation periods. Multivariable unconditional logistic regression identified factors associated with PEP receipt, while Cox proportional hazards models, Mann–Whitney U tests, and Kruskal–Wallis H tests were used to examine factors associated with the incubation period. Chi-square or Fisher's exact tests compared standard and non-standard PEP cases. Results Among 930 human rabies deaths, most patients were male, rural farmers, and middle-aged or older adults. Dogs caused 86.88% of exposures, yet only 1.83% of owned biting animals had documented rabies vaccination. PEP uptake was very low: 852 cases (91.62%) received no prophylaxis whatsoever, and only 51 cases (5.48%) received rabies vaccine. Non-category III exposure, wounds at lower-risk sites, injury by household animals, and single-victim incidents were associated with lower likelihood of receiving wound care, vaccination, or rabies immunoglobulin. Among 697 cases with a documented incubation period, the median was 70 days (IQR: 38–134.5). Head, face, or neck exposure and multiple-victim incidents were independently associated with shorter incubation periods. Seventy-eight patients developed rabies despite receiving at least one prophylaxis measure; 60 (76.92%) had clearly non-standard PEP, whereas 18 (23.08%) had no identifiable procedural failure. These possible breakthrough infections accounted for 1.94% of all cases and were characterized by category III exposure, head, face, or neck injuries, stray-dog bites, and a short median incubation period of 16 days. Conclusion Most human rabies deaths in China resulted from a failure to initiate or complete PEP, reflecting preventable gaps in risk perception, access, affordability, and follow-up. Possible breakthrough infections were rare but were concentrated in extremely high-risk exposures. Targeted health education, improved prophylaxis adherence, integrated bite case management, and strengthened dog vaccination under a One Health framework are essential to eliminate dog-mediated human rabies deaths.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是一种致命但可预防的人畜共患疾病,继续对中国,特别是农村人口构成公共卫生威胁。本研究旨在描述人类 狂犬病 死亡中的暴露模式、PEP 使用以及可能的突破性感染。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项全国性回顾性狂犬病研究分析了中国国家狂犬病系统的数据,涵盖2019年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间报告的人类狂犬病病例。该研究包括930例人类狂犬病死亡病例,其中大多数是男性、农民和中老年人。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究对人口特征、暴露信息、动物来源、伤口部位、PEP 措施和潜伏期进行了回顾性横断面分析。多变量无条件逻辑回归和 Cox 比例风险模型分别用于检查与 PEP 接受和潜伏期相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在930例狂犬病死亡病例中,大多数患者是男性、农村农民和中老年人。非 III 类暴露、低风险部位的伤口、家畜伤害和单一受害者事件与接受伤口护理、疫苗接种 或 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白的可能性较低相关。可能的突破性感染占所有病例的 1.94%,其特点是 III 类暴露、头部、面部或颈部受伤、流浪狗咬伤以及中位潜伏期较短(16 天)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,中国大多数人类死亡是由于未能启动或完成 PEP 造成的,凸显了在风险认知、获取、负担能力和后续行动方面存在可预防的差距。可能的突破性感染很少见,但集中在极高风险的暴露中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了关于 狂犬病 暴露和 PEP 使用模式的重要见解,可以为有针对性的健康教育、提高预防依从性和综合咬伤病例管理提供信息,以减少 狂犬病 死亡。它还强调了在 One Health 框架下加强狗 疫苗接种 计划的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,这可能会引入回忆偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。鉴于统计模型的全国范围和使用,证据是强有力的,但对报告病例的依赖可能无法完全捕获 狂犬病 暴露和 PEP 失败的所有实例。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 狂犬病 仍然是一种致命但可预防的人畜共患疾病,继续对中国,特别是农村人口构成公共卫生威胁。尽管 暴露后预防 (PEP) 在及时、正确的情况下非常有效,但仍然会发生死亡,包括尽管采取预防措施仍发生的罕见感染。本研究描述了 2019 年至 2024 年中国人类 狂犬病 死亡中的暴露模式、PEP 使用情况和可能的突破性感染。方法我们对中国国家 狂犬病 监测 系统的数据进行了回顾性横断面分析。包括2019年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间报告的临床诊断和实验室确诊的人类狂犬病病例。我们分析了人口特征、暴露信息、动物来源、伤口部位、PEP 措施和潜伏期。多变量无条件逻辑回归确定了与 PEP 接受相关的因素,而 Cox 比例风险模型、Mann-Whitney U 检验和 Kruskal-Wallis H 检验用于检查与潜伏期相关的因素。卡方或 Fisher 精确检验比较了标准和非标准 PEP 病例。结果 930例狂犬病死亡病例中,以男性、农村农民、中老年人为主。86.88% 的接触是由狗引起的,但只有 1.83% 的自养咬伤动物记录了 狂犬病 疫苗接种。PEP 的使用率非常低:852 例(91.62%)没有接受任何预防治疗,只有 51 例(5.48%)接受了 狂犬病 疫苗。非 III 类暴露、低风险部位的伤口、家畜伤害和单一受害者事件与接受伤口护理、疫苗接种 或 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白的可能性较低相关。在有记录的 697 例潜伏期中,中位数为 70 天(IQR:38-134.5)。头部、面部或颈部暴露和多重受害者事件与较短的潜伏期独立相关。尽管接受了至少一种预防措施,仍有 78 名患者出现了 狂犬病;60 名(76.92%)有明显不标准的 PEP,而 18 名(23.08%)没有可识别的程序失败。这些可能的突破性感染占所有病例的 1.94%,其特点是 III 类暴露、头部、面部或颈部受伤、流浪狗咬伤以及中位潜伏期较短(16 天)。结论 中国大多数人类 狂犬病 死亡是由于未能启动或完成 PEP 造成的,反映出在风险认知、获取、负担能力和随访方面存在可预防的差距。可能的突破性感染很少见,但集中在极高风险的暴露中。有针对性的健康教育、提高预防依从性、综合咬伤病例管理以及在“同一个健康”框架下加强狗 狂犬病 对于消除狗介导的人类 狂犬病 死亡至关重要。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是一种致命但可预防的人畜共患疾病,继续对中国,特别是农村人口构成公共卫生威胁。本研究旨在描述人类 狂犬病 死亡中的暴露模式、PEP 使用以及可能的突破性感染。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项全国性回顾性狂犬病研究分析了中国国家狂犬病系统的数据,涵盖2019年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间报告的人类狂犬病病例。该研究包括930例人类狂犬病死亡病例,其中大多数是男性、农民和中老年人。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究对人口特征、暴露信息、动物来源、伤口部位、PEP 措施和潜伏期进行了回顾性横断面分析。多变量无条件逻辑回归和 Cox 比例风险模型分别用于检查与 PEP 接受和潜伏期相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在930例狂犬病死亡病例中,大多数患者是男性、农村农民和中老年人。非 III 类暴露、低风险部位的伤口、家畜伤害和单一受害者事件与接受伤口护理、疫苗接种 或 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白的可能性较低相关。可能的突破性感染占所有病例的 1.94%,其特点是 III 类暴露、头部、面部或颈部受伤、流浪狗咬伤以及中位潜伏期较短(16 天)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,中国大多数人类死亡是由于未能启动或完成 PEP 造成的,凸显了在风险认知、获取、负担能力和后续行动方面存在可预防的差距。可能的突破性感染很少见,但集中在极高风险的暴露中。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了关于 狂犬病 暴露和 PEP 使用模式的重要见解,可以为有针对性的健康教育、提高预防依从性和综合咬伤病例管理提供信息,以减少 狂犬病 死亡。它还强调了在 One Health 框架下加强狗 疫苗接种 计划的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,这可能会引入回忆偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。鉴于统计模型的全国范围和使用,证据是强有力的,但对报告病例的依赖可能无法完全捕获 狂犬病 暴露和 PEP 失败的所有实例。

Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học bệnh dại, và mối liên quan giữa vị trí, mức độ vết thương và thời gian ủ bệnh dại trên người khu vực phía Nam . Ca bệnh dại có hội chứng viêm não tủy cấp: sợ nước, gió, ánh sáng hoặc triệu chứng liệt, tiến triển hôn mê, tử vong sau 7-10 ngày. Kiểm định Mann–Whitney U và hồi quy phân vị đa biến tại trung vị (τ=0,5) được sử dụng để đánh giá liên quan giữa vị trí, mức độ vết thương và thời gian ủ bệnh. Có 175 ca trên người, 426 ổ dịch động vật tại 8/8 tỉnh, thành. Có 76 ca (43,4%) ≥50 tuổi; lao động tự do và nông dân chiếm 59,4%. Có 90,3% người bị chó cắn. analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu được thực hiện để mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh dại trên người và mối liên quan giữa vị trí, mức độ vết thương và thời gian ủ bệnh trong khu vực phía Nam từ năm 2018 đến 2025. Bệnh dại có tỷ lệ tử vong gần như 100% khi đã khởi phát, và dù có vắc xin, tỷ lệ ca bệnh ở khu vực này vẫn cao hơn trung bình cả nước.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học bệnh dại trên người tại 8 tỉnh, thành phố phía Nam Việt Nam trong thời gian từ năm 2018 đến 2025. Tổng cộng có 175 ca bệnh được ghi nhận, cùng với 426 ổ dịch động vật được xác định trong nghiên cứu này.
analysis.methods: Nghiên cứu sử dụng kiểm định Mann–Whitney U và hồi quy phân vị đa biến tại trung vị (τ=0,5) để đánh giá mối liên quan giữa vị trí, mức độ vết thương và thời gian ủ bệnh. Các ca bệnh được phân loại dựa trên triệu chứng lâm sàng và thông tin về nguồn lây, thời gian ủ bệnh và cách xử lý vết thương.
analysis.main_results: Có 76 ca (43,4%) ≥50 tuổi, lao động tự do và nông dân chiếm 59,4%. 90,3% ca bệnh do chó cắn, 48,6% ca bị cắn vùng nhiều đầu dây thần kinh, 35,4% không xử lý vết thương và 96,0% không tiêm phòng dại. Thời gian ủ bệnh trung vị là 88 ngày, với sự khác biệt đáng kể giữa các nhóm vết thương.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu xác định rằng các yếu tố như tuổi tác, nghề nghiệp và cách xử lý vết thương có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến thời gian ủ bệnh của bệnh dại. Các kết quả này cung cấp cái nhìn sâu sắc về đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh dại trong khu vực phía Nam, đặc biệt là mối liên hệ giữa mức độ tổn thương và thời gian ủ bệnh.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả nghiên cứu có thể hỗ trợ trong việc cải thiện chiến lược phòng ngừa và can thiệp sớm bệnh dại, đặc biệt là ở những nhóm nguy cơ cao như lao động tự do và nông dân. Việc hiểu rõ thời gian ủ bệnh và các yếu tố ảnh hưởng có thể giúp nâng cao hiệu quả của các chương trình tiêm chủng và xử lý vết thương.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu báo cáo, có thể bị ảnh hưởng bởi độ chính xác của thông tin thu thập. Tuy nhiên, các phương pháp thống kê được sử dụng là phù hợp và có thể cung cấp bằng chứng trung bình với độ tin cậy cao.

analysis.summary_en: Nghiên cứu tập trung vào đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh dại trên người tại khu vực phía Nam Việt Nam từ năm 2018 đến 2025. Các kết quả cho thấy tỷ lệ ca bệnh vẫn cao dù có vắc xin, với 90,3% ca do chó cắn và 48,6% ca bị cắn vùng nhiều đầu dây thần kinh. Thời gian ủ bệnh trung vị là 88 ngày, và các yếu tố như tuổi tác, nghề nghiệp và cách xử lý vết thương có ảnh hưởng đến thời gian ủ bệnh. Nghiên cứu sử dụng kiểm định Mann–Whitney U và hồi quy phân vị đa biến để phân tích mối liên hệ giữa các yếu tố này. Các phát hiện có thể hỗ trợ cải thiện chiến lược phòng ngừa và can thiệp sớm bệnh dại, đặc biệt là ở nhóm nguy cơ cao. Tuy nhiên, nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu báo cáo, có thể bị ảnh hưởng bởi độ chính xác của thông tin thu thập.

papers.title: Zoonotic diseases posing occupational risk to veterinary personnel during clinical management of dogs and cats: A narrative review.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Veterinary professionals are among the occupational groups most exposed to zoonotic infections, and the exposure mainly occurs during the everyday clinical treatment of common household pets. Dogs and cats carry a wide and taxonomically varied range of zoonotic pathogens. These are able to infect people in several ways: through bites and scratches, via contact with urine or faeces, by inhaling aerosols, through direct contact on the skin, and also by arthropods what patients carry into the clinic. Objectives This review focuses on the different zoonoses types that dogs and cats are able to transmit to veterinary personnel. Hereby, we describe the cause, the route of infection at work, the clinical presentation in humans, and the available approaches for the diagnosis, treatment as well as for the prevention. Results More than twenty zoonoses of occupational relevance were identified, falling into four groups: bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic (protozoan, helminth, and ectoparasitic). The most serious ones are rabies, Q fever, cat-scratch disease, leptospirosis, pasteurellosis, dermatophytosis, toxoplasmosis, and sporotrichosis. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear unless post-exposure prophylaxis is given. Q fever and capnocytophagosis can also become life-threatening in particular host contexts. Conclusions The occupational risk in small animal practice is substantial, and it rarely comes down to a single pathogen. Four measures matter most: pre-exposure vaccination where it exists (rabies, and Q fever in endemic regions), consistent use of personal protective equipment (PPE), careful bite-wound management, and specific precautions for individuals at higher risk, particularly those who are pregnant or immunocompromised.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the significant occupational risk of zoonotic diseases for veterinary personnel working with dogs and cats. Rabies virus is identified as one of the most serious pathogens, with a high fatality rate once symptoms appear. The review outlines various transmission routes, including bites, scratches, contact with bodily fluids, and exposure to arthropods. It emphasizes the importance of pre-exposure vaccination, personal protective equipment, and targeted precautions for high-risk individuals. The findings underscore the need for comprehensive strategies to mitigate the risk of rabies and other zoonotic infections in veterinary settings.

papers.title_zh: 在狗和猫的临床管理过程中,人畜共患疾病对兽医人员构成职业风险:叙述性回顾。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Veterinary professionals are among the occupational groups most exposed to zoonotic infections, and the exposure mainly occurs during the everyday clinical treatment of common household pets. Dogs and cats carry a wide and taxonomically varied range of zoonotic pathogens. These are able to infect people in several ways: through bites and scratches, via contact with urine or faeces, by inhaling aerosols, through direct contact on the skin, and also by arthropods what patients carry into the clinic. Objectives This review focuses on the different zoonoses types that dogs and cats are able to transmit to veterinary personnel. Hereby, we describe the cause, the route of infection at work, the clinical presentation in humans, and the available approaches for the diagnosis, treatment as well as for the prevention. Results More than twenty zoonoses of occupational relevance were identified, falling into four groups: bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasitic (protozoan, helminth, and ectoparasitic). The most serious ones are rabies, Q fever, cat-scratch disease, leptospirosis, pasteurellosis, dermatophytosis, toxoplasmosis, and sporotrichosis. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear unless post-exposure prophylaxis is given. Q fever and capnocytophagosis can also become life-threatening in particular host contexts. Conclusions The occupational risk in small animal practice is substantial, and it rarely comes down to a single pathogen. Four measures matter most: pre-exposure vaccination where it exists (rabies, and Q fever in endemic regions), consistent use of personal protective equipment (PPE), careful bite-wound management, and specific precautions for individuals at higher risk, particularly those who are pregnant or immunocompromised.

papers.title: Comparative Long-Term Immunogenicity and Boosting of 3-Session Versus 4-Session Intradermal Rabies Post-Exposure Prophylaxis Regimens in Cambodia and Madagascar: The RESIST-3 Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The abridged Institut Pasteur du Cambodge 3-session intradermal (ID) rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimen has been shown to be as safe and immunogenic as the 4-session regimen previously recommended by the World Health Organization. This regimen reduces time and cost and improves adherence and access to PEP for underserved people. In our study, we aimed to compare long-term and anamnestic immune response after a rabies vaccine booster dose in people previously vaccinated with a 3- or 4-session ID PEP. METHODS: In this prospective, multisite, comparative immunogenicity study, we measured rabies virus (RABV)-neutralizing antibody in 181 persons who had previously received 3- or 4-session ID PEP 2, 5, or 10 years earlier in Cambodia or Madagascar at day 0 and day 7 after a booster. In addition, RABV-specific T-cell response was evaluated in a subgroup of 35 Cambodian participants. RESULTS: All participants had RABV-neutralizing antibody titers considered adequate (≥0.5 IU/mL) on day 7 after the booster dose. The overall geometric mean titer of rabies antibody on day 0 and day 7 did not differ significantly between the 2 groups. Furthermore, RABV-specific T-cell response was similar regardless of the ID PEP regimen initially received in a subgroup of 35 participants. CONCLUSIONS: In this multisite, real-world study, we showed that the 3-session ID PEP regimen provides robust long-term immunogenicity for up to 10 years after initial PEP and ensures the induction of an adequate anamnestic response within 7 days after an additional booster in all participants.
papers.journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare long-term and anamnestic immune response after a rabies vaccine booster dose in people previously vaccinated with a 3- or 4-session intradermal post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimen. The background highlights that the 3-session intradermal PEP regimen has been shown to be as safe and immunogenic as the 4-session regimen previously recommended by the World Health Organization.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This prospective, multisite, comparative immunogenicity study was conducted in Cambodia and Madagascar. It included 181 participants who had previously received 3- or 4-session intradermal PEP 2, 5, or 10 years earlier and were assessed at day 0 and day 7 after a booster dose.
analysis.methods: Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers were measured in all participants, and RABV-specific T-cell responses were evaluated in a subgroup of 35 Cambodian participants. The study involved measuring immune responses at specific time points post-booster.
analysis.main_results: All participants had rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers considered adequate (≥0.5 IU/mL) on day 7 after the booster dose. The overall geometric mean titer of rabies antibody on day 0 and day 7 did not differ significantly between the 3-session and 4-session groups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the 3-session intradermal PEP regimen provides robust long-term immunogenicity for up to 10 years after initial PEP and ensures the induction of an adequate anamnestic response within 7 days after an additional booster in all participants.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the potential use of a 3-session intradermal PEP regimen as a viable alternative to the 4-session regimen, offering benefits in terms of time, cost, and adherence for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis in resource-limited settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a real-world, multisite comparison, which may introduce variability in participant characteristics and settings. The evidence is strong, with all participants showing adequate antibody titers post-booster, and no significant differences observed between the groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared the long-term immunogenicity and anamnestic response of a 3-session intradermal rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimen with a 4-session regimen in Cambodia and Madagascar. The 3-session regimen was found to be as effective as the 4-session regimen in maintaining adequate rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers (≥0.5 IU/mL) after a booster dose, with no significant differences in geometric mean titers between the groups. The results suggest that the 3-session regimen could be a more efficient and cost-effective option for rabies PEP, particularly in underserved populations. However, the study's real-world setting may introduce variability, and the evidence is strong due to consistent antibody responses across all participants. The findings have important implications for improving access to rabies post-exposure prophylaxis in resource-limited areas.

papers.title_zh: 柬埔寨和马达加斯加 3 疗程与 4 疗程皮内 狂犬病 暴露后预防 方案的长期免疫原性比较和增强:RESIST-3 研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The abridged Institut Pasteur du Cambodge 3-session intradermal (ID) rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimen has been shown to be as safe and immunogenic as the 4-session regimen previously recommended by the World Health Organization. This regimen reduces time and cost and improves adherence and access to PEP for underserved people. In our study, we aimed to compare long-term and anamnestic immune response after a rabies vaccine booster dose in people previously vaccinated with a 3- or 4-session ID PEP. METHODS: In this prospective, multisite, comparative immunogenicity study, we measured rabies virus (RABV)-neutralizing antibody in 181 persons who had previously received 3- or 4-session ID PEP 2, 5, or 10 years earlier in Cambodia or Madagascar at day 0 and day 7 after a booster. In addition, RABV-specific T-cell response was evaluated in a subgroup of 35 Cambodian participants. RESULTS: All participants had RABV-neutralizing antibody titers considered adequate (≥0.5 IU/mL) on day 7 after the booster dose. The overall geometric mean titer of rabies antibody on day 0 and day 7 did not differ significantly between the 2 groups. Furthermore, RABV-specific T-cell response was similar regardless of the ID PEP regimen initially received in a subgroup of 35 participants. CONCLUSIONS: In this multisite, real-world study, we showed that the 3-session ID PEP regimen provides robust long-term immunogenicity for up to 10 years after initial PEP and ensures the induction of an adequate anamnestic response within 7 days after an additional booster in all participants.

papers.title: Immunogenicity and safety of Institut Pasteur du Cambodge (IPC) and updated Thai Red Cross (UTRC) intradermal rabies vaccine regimens among healthy adults in India: A phase 4, open label, equivalence randomised controlled trial
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Shorter rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimens could improve compliance and access by reducing the number of clinic visits and vaccine requirement per patient. We compared the immunogenicity and safety of a 1-week intradermal Institut Pasteur du Cambodge (IPC) regimen with a 1-month intradermal Updated Thai Red Cross regimen (UTRC) using two rabies vaccines widely used in India: Purified Chick Embryo Cell vaccine (PCECV) and the Purified Vero Cell Rabies vaccine (PVRV). METHODS AND FINDINGS: We conducted a phase 4, single-centre, open-label randomised controlled equivalence trial among adult healthy volunteers. Participants were block randomised (1:1:1:1) to receive either the IPC (Days 0, 3, 7) or UTRC (Days 0, 3, 7, 28) intradermal regimen with either PCECV or the PVRV. Rabies virus neutralizing antibody (RVNA) titres were measured up to 1 year. The primary objective of the trial was to determine the immunogenicity of the Intradermal abridged Cambodia regimen with updated intradermal Thai red cross regimen using two different vaccine types among healthy volunteers in India. The primary outcome was geometric mean concentration ratios (GMR) of RVNA on day 42, assessed separately for each vaccine type. Equivalence for each vaccine was predefined as the entire 95% confidence interval for GMR lying between 0.72 and 1.04. The secondary outcomes included proportion of participants with RVNA titres >= 0.5 IU/mL on Days 14, 28, 42, 90, 180, and 365 and vaccine safety. Between October 10, 2023, and December 23, 2023, 400 participants were randomly assigned (100 per group) to PCECV-IPC, PCECV-UTRC, PVRV-IPC, and PVRV-UTRC. 362 (90.5%) completed PEP regimen and blood draw on day 42. In the prespecified modified intention-to-treat analysis, the Day 42 GMR (IPC vs UTRC) was 0.59 (95% CI: 0.47-0.75) for PCECV and 0.76 (95% CI: 0.61-0.95) for PVRV, which did not meet the prespecified equivalence criterion. All participants, irrespective of baseline serostatus, in four groups had RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/ml at every assessment from day 14-1 year. Adverse events were similar between regimens and mostly mild. There are important limitations in this study. Nearly one-quarter of participants had baseline RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/mL despite exclusion of participants with a reported history of rabies vaccination or dog bite, suggesting unrecognised prior immunological priming that may have influenced GMC estimates. As the trial was conducted among healthy volunteers rather than people receiving PEP after animal bites, the findings may not fully reflect vaccine performance in routine post-exposure settings. CONCLUSION: The IPC regimen did not meet the prespecified equivalence criterion compared to UTRC. All participants achieved RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/ml indicative of seroprotection from day 14 till 1 year. Policy decisions regarding replacement of UTRC should consider these immunogenicity findings together with compliance, cost, and vaccine availability. TRIAL REGISTRATION: The trial was registered with the Clinical Trial Registry - India (CTRI/2023/10/058418). URL: https://ctri.nic.in/Clinicaltrials/pmaindet2.php?EncHid=OTAxMDA=&Enc=&userName=).

We compared the immunogenicity and safety of a 1-week intradermal Institut Pasteur du Cambodge (IPC) regimen with a 1-month intradermal Updated Thai Red Cross regimen (UTRC) using two rabies vaccines widely used in India: Purified Chick Embryo Cell vaccine (PCECV) and the Purified Vero Cell Rabies vaccine (PVRV). METHODS AND FINDINGS We conducted a phase 4, single-centre, open-label randomised controlled equivalence trial among adult healthy volunteers. Participants were block randomised (1:1:1:1) to receive either the IPC (Days 0, 3, 7) or UTRC (Days 0, 3, 7, 28) intradermal regimen with either PCECV or the PVRV. Rabies virus neutralizing antibody (RVNA) titres were measured up to 1 year. The primary objective of the trial was to determine the immunogenicity of the Intradermal abridged Cambodia regimen with updated intradermal Thai red cross regimen using two different vaccine types among healthy volunteers in India. The primary outcome was geometric mean concentration ratios (GMR) of RVNA on day 42, assessed separately for each vaccine type. Equivalence for each vaccine was predefined as the entire 95% confidence interval for GMR lying between 0.72 and 1.04. The secondary outcomes included proportion of participants with RVNA titres >= 0.5 IU/mL on Days 14, 28, 42, 90, 180, and 365 and vaccine safety. Between October 10, 2023, and December 23, 2023, 400 participants were randomly assigned (100 per group) to PCECV-IPC, PCECV-UTRC, PVRV-IPC, and PVRV-UTRC. 362 (90.5%) completed PEP regimen and blood draw on day 42. In the prespecified modified intention-to-treat analysis, the Day 42 GMR (IPC vs UTRC) was 0.59 (95% CI: 0.47-0.75) for PCECV and 0.76 (95% CI: 0.61-0.95) for PVRV, which did not meet the prespecified equivalence criterion. All participants, irrespective of baseline serostatus, in four groups had RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/ml at every assessment from day 14-1 year. Adverse events were similar between regimens and mostly mild. There are important limitations in this study. Nearly one-quarter of participants had baseline RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/mL despite exclusion of participants with a reported history of rabies vaccination or dog bite, suggesting unrecognised prior immunological priming that may have influenced GMC estimates. As the trial was conducted among healthy volunteers rather than people receiving PEP after animal bites, the findings may not fully reflect vaccine performance in routine post-exposure settings. CONCLUSION The IPC regimen did not meet the prespecified equivalence criterion compared to UTRC. All participants achieved RVNA titres ≥0.5 IU/ml indicative of seroprotection from day 14 till 1 year. Policy decisions regarding replacement of UTRC should consider these immunogenicity findings together with compliance, cost, and vaccine availability. TRIAL REGISTRATION The trial was registered with the Clinical Trial Registry - India (CTRI/2023/10/058418). URL: https://ctri.nic.in/Clinicaltrials/pmaindet2.php?EncHid=OTAxMDA=&Enc=&userName=).

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare the immunogenicity and safety of a 1-week intradermal Institut Pasteur du Cambodge (IPC) regimen with a 1-month intradermal Updated Thai Red Cross (UTRC) regimen using two rabies vaccines, PCECV and PVRV, among healthy adults in India. A phase 4, open-label, equivalence randomised controlled trial was conducted with 400 participants randomly assigned to four groups. RVNA titres were measured up to 1 year, with the primary outcome being the geometric mean concentration ratios (GMR) on day 42. The findings suggest that while the IPC regimen may not be equivalent to UTRC, it still provides adequate immunogenicity. The study's limitations include the potential influence of baseline immunological priming and the fact that it was conducted among healthy volunteers rather than individuals receiving post-exposure prophylaxis after animal bites. These results have implications for policy decisions regarding vaccine replacement, considering compliance, cost, and availability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 较短的 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (PEP) 方案可以通过减少就诊次数和每位患者的 疫苗 需求来提高依从性和可及性。我们使用印度广泛使用的两种 狂犬病 疫苗:纯化的鸡胚细胞 疫苗 (PCECV) 和纯化的 Vero 细胞 狂犬病,比较了 1 周皮内注射柬埔寨巴斯德研究所 (IPC) 方案与 1 个月皮内更新泰国红十字会方案 (UTRC) 的免疫原性和安全性。疫苗 (PVRV)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: We conducted a phase 4, single-centre, open-label randomised controlled equivalence trial among adult healthy volunteers. Participants were block randomised (1:1:1:1) to receive either the IPC (Days 0, 3, 7) or UTRC (Days 0, 3, 7, 28) intradermal regimen with either PCECV or the PVRV. Between October 10, 2023, and December 23, 2023, 400 participants were randomly assigned (100 per group) to PCECV-IPC, PCECV-UTRC, PVRV-IPC, and PVRV-UTRC.
elements_zh.methods: 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体 (RVNA) 滴度测量长达 1 年。主要结果是第 42 天的 RVNA 几何平均浓度比 (GMR),针对每种 疫苗 类型分别进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 每个 疫苗 的等效性被预定义为 GMR 的整个 95% 置信区间位于 0.72 和 1.04 之间。在预先指定的改良意向治疗分析中,PCECV 的第 42 天 GMR(IPC 与 UTRC)为 0.59(95% CI:0.47-0.75),PVRV 为 0.76(95% CI:0.61-0.95),不符合预先指定的等效标准。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 与 UTRC 相比,IPC 方案不符合预先指定的等效标准。从第 14 天到 1 年,所有参与者的 RVNA 滴度均达到≥0.5 IU/ml,表明血清保护。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 关于更换 UTRC 的政策决策应考虑这些免疫原性发现以及合规性、成本和 疫苗 可用性。研究结果可能无法完全反映 疫苗 在常规暴露后环境中的表现。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这项研究存在重要的局限性。尽管排除了有 狂犬病 疫苗接种 或狗咬伤病史的参与者,但仍有近四分之一的参与者基线 RVNA 滴度≥0.5 IU/mL,这表明之前未被识别的免疫启动可能影响了 GMC 估计。

papers.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding priority zoonotic diseases (Mpox, Ebola, and Rabies) and associated factors among households in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2025
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Zoonotic diseases are a major public health concern in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where diseases such as rabies, Ebola, and Mpox pose ongoing health risks. Household knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) play an important role in preventing zoonotic disease transmission. This study assessed household knowledge, attitudes, and practices regarding priority zoonotic diseases in Bukavu, South Kivu Province, DRC, and identified factors associated with satisfactory overall KAP. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted from September 1 to 15, 2025, in the Bagira and Kadutu health zones of Bukavu. A total of 634 households were selected using two-stage cluster sampling. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire administered through KoboCollect and analyzed using Stata version 17. The questionnaire assessed knowledge, attitudes, and practices concerning Ebola, Mpox, and rabies. Knowledge was measured using 17 items, attitudes using five-point Likert-scale items, and practices using five behavioral items. Scores of at least 70% were classified as satisfactory. Descriptive statistics, group comparisons, and bivariate and multivariable logistic regression analyses were used. Nonparametric tests were used when appropriate. Associations were reported as odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant. Results: Overall, 42.9% of households demonstrated satisfactory knowledge of zoonotic diseases, 63.6% had favorable attitudes, and 11.7% demonstrated adequate preventive practices. Mpox was recognized as a zoonosis by 78.2% of respondents, Ebola by 66.6%, and rabies by 39.1%. Knowledge scores were higher among livestock-farming than non-livestock-farming households (p = 0.002). In the multivariable analysis of overall KAP, university-level education (OR = 12.06; 95% CI: 1.54-94.18; p = 0.018) and access to drinking water (OR = 6.74; 95% CI: 3.91-11.60; p < 0.001) were positively associated with satisfactory overall KAP. Conclusions: Households in Bukavu reported generally favorable attitudes toward zoonotic disease prevention, but satisfactory knowledge was less widespread and adequate preventive practices were uncommon. Interventions should help translate awareness and favorable attitudes into practical preventive behaviors through targeted risk communication and health education, alongside improvements in access to drinking water and sanitation. A coordinated One Health approach involving human, animal, and environmental health stakeholders may strengthen household-level prevention of priority zoonotic diseases. The findings can help inform locally tailored prevention strategies and identify priorities for future community-based research. Keywords: Zoonoses; Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices; One Health; Bukavu; Democratic Republic of the Congo

papers.title: Peer Review Report For: Development and Characterization of Pseudotype-based Microneutralization Assay to Assess Functionality of Anti-rabies Protein G Antibodies [version 2; peer review: 2 approved]
papers.abstract: Background Rabies virus (RABV) is a neurotropic zoonotic pathogen responsible for an estimated 60,000 human deaths annually. Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.

papers.title_zh: 同行评审报告:用于评估抗 狂犬病 蛋白 G 抗体功能的基于假型的微量中和测定的开发和表征 [版本 2;同行评审:2 项批准]
papers.source_body_en: Background Rabies virus (RABV) is a neurotropic zoonotic pathogen responsible for an estimated 60,000 human deaths annually. Despite widespread vaccination programs, rabies remains a substantial public health burden, particularly in regions with limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Standard serological assays for evaluating rabies vaccine immunogenicity, including the Rapid Fluorescent Focus Inhibition Test (RFFIT) and the Fluorescent Antibody Virus Neutralization (FAVN) test, require live virus handling under biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) conditions, limiting their scalability and broader implementation. Methods We developed and characterized a pseudotype-based microneutralization assay using a lentiviral HIV-1 backbone to generate pseudotyped viral particles expressing glycoproteins from three antigenically distinct rabies virus strains: CTN-1 V5, CVS-11, and Pasteur. Neutralization assays were performed under BSL-2 conditions, and assay performance was evaluated in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and suitability for high-throughput applications. Results The pseudotype-based assay enabled sensitive and reproducible detection of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies across the three glycoprotein variants. The platform demonstrated robust performance under BSL-2 containment, supporting efficient and scalable testing. Inclusion of antigenically distinct strains broadened detection capacity and improved the assessment of strain-specific neutralizing responses. Conclusions This pseudotype-based microneutralization assay represents a safe, flexible, and scalable alternative to conventional live-virus neutralization tests. By enabling high-throughput rabies serology under BSL-2 conditions, this platform supports vaccine evaluation and seroepidemiological surveillance, particularly in settings where BSL-3 infrastructure is limited.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 是一种嗜神经性人畜共患病原体,每年估计导致 60,000 人死亡。尽管 疫苗接种 计划广泛传播,但 狂犬病 仍然是巨大的公共卫生负担,特别是在 暴露后预防 (PEP) 获取机会有限的地区。用于评估 狂犬病 疫苗 免疫原性的标准血清学测定,包括快速荧光聚焦抑制试验 (RFFIT) 和荧光抗体病毒中和 (FAVN) 试验,需要在生物安全 3 级 (BSL-3) 条件下处理活病毒,限制了其可扩展性和更广泛的实施。方法我们开发并表征了一种基于假型的微中和测定,使用慢病毒 HIV-1 主链生成表达来自三种抗原不同的 狂犬病病毒 菌株(CTN-1 V5、CVS-11 和巴斯德)的糖蛋白的假型病毒颗粒。中和测定在 BSL-2 条件下进行,并从灵敏度、特异性和高通量应用的适用性方面评估测定性能。结果基于假型的测定能够灵敏且可重复地检测三种糖蛋白变体的 狂犬病病毒 中和抗体。该平台在 BSL-2 遏制下表现出强大的性能,支持高效且可扩展的测试。包含抗原性不同的菌株扩大了检测能力并改进了菌株特异性中和反应的评估。结论 这种基于假型的微量中和试验是传统活病毒中和试验的一种安全、灵活且可扩展的替代方法。通过在 BSL-2 条件下启用高通量 狂犬病 血清学,该平台支持 疫苗 评估和血清流行病学 监测,特别是在 BSL-3 基础设施有限的环境中。

papers.title: Prediction of Rabies Spread in Dogs and Humans in Muara Enim Regency Based on the SI–SEIR Model with Fourth-Order Runge–Kutta Numerical Solution
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease that is generally transmitted through the bite of an infected dog. This research aims to predict the spread of rabies in dog and human populations in Muara Enim Regency using a combined SI–SEIR mathematical model. The system of nonlinear differential equations was solved using the fourth-order Runge–Kutta (RK4) method. Rabies data on dogs and humans were obtained from the Lampung Veterinary Center for the period 2021–2024. The simulation results show that the number of infected dogs increased significantly at the beginning of the period, peaked in the third year, and then declined as the population of susceptible dogs decreased. In the human population, the increase in exposed and infected individuals occurred after the surge in the dog population, indicating cross-species transmission. This model provides a quantitative overview of rabies dynamics and can be used as a basis for rabies control strategies in Muara Enim Regency.

papers.title: Structure of vesicular stomatitis virus L-P-N 0 complex by cyro-electron microscopy.
papers.abstract: The large protein (L) of nonsegmented, negative-strand RNA viruses, a viral order that includes rabies, Ebola, Nipah, and respiratory syncytial viruses, catalyze RNA-dependent RNA polymerization on nucleocapsid-sheathed RNA templates. L coordinates two distinct processes: messenger RNA (mRNA) transcription and genome replication. During transcription, L catalyzes cotranscriptional mRNA capping, methylation, and polyadenylation. The additional activities are not required during genome replication; instead, RNA synthesis is coupled to encapsidation by soluble nucleoprotein (N 0 ) recruited by the phosphoprotein (P). We determined the structure of a vesicular stomatitis virus polymerase complex comprising L-P and N 0 . P directly engages the carboxyl-terminal domain of L (L CTD ) to anchor N 0 in a continuum of conformations including a more stable configuration with N 0 positioned at the RNA-product exit channel, poised for encapsidation. This study reveals a function for L CTD in encapsidation of nascent RNAs and provides the structure of a polymerase complex required for genomic RNA replication.

papers.title_zh: 通过冷冻电镜观察水泡性口炎病毒 L-P-N 0 复合物的结构。
papers.source_body_en: The large protein (L) of nonsegmented, negative-strand RNA viruses, a viral order that includes rabies, Ebola, Nipah, and respiratory syncytial viruses, catalyze RNA-dependent RNA polymerization on nucleocapsid-sheathed RNA templates. L coordinates two distinct processes: messenger RNA (mRNA) transcription and genome replication. During transcription, L catalyzes cotranscriptional mRNA capping, methylation, and polyadenylation. The additional activities are not required during genome replication; instead, RNA synthesis is coupled to encapsidation by soluble nucleoprotein (N 0 ) recruited by the phosphoprotein (P). We determined the structure of a vesicular stomatitis virus polymerase complex comprising L-P and N 0 . P directly engages the carboxyl-terminal domain of L (L CTD ) to anchor N 0 in a continuum of conformations including a more stable configuration with N 0 positioned at the RNA-product exit channel, poised for encapsidation. This study reveals a function for L CTD in encapsidation of nascent RNAs and provides the structure of a polymerase complex required for genomic RNA replication.

papers.title: Modeling long-range human nigrostriatal connectivity in vitro reveals striatal target-dependent maturation of dopamine neurons.
papers.abstract: The human nigrostriatal pathway, comprising dopaminergic neurons in the ventral midbrain that project to the dorsolateral striatum, is essential for motor control and selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's disease. How this circuit assembles during human development remains poorly understood, and in vitro models capturing its long-range connectivity and spatial organization have been lacking. Here, we establish a compartmentalized, human stem cell-based model of the nigrostriatal pathway by integrating ventral midbrain and striatal organoids within a custom-engineered microfluidic device that confines cell bodies while guiding axonal growth to recapitulate key aspects of in vivo topography. Functional connectivity was confirmed by retrograde rabies tracing, and optogenetic and pharmacological stimulation. Single-nucleus transcriptomic analysis reveals that axonal target engagement with spatially separated striatal neurons promotes maturation of human dopaminergic neurons and activates transcriptional programs associated with neurotransmitter secretion. Our study establishes a biologically relevant in vitro system for investigating how long-range connectivity regulates neuronal assembly in the nigrostriatal circuit and for modelling key pathological features of Parkinson's disease.

papers.title_zh: 体外模拟人类黑质纹状体的长距离连接揭示了多巴胺神经元的纹状体目标依赖性成熟。
papers.source_body_en: The human nigrostriatal pathway, comprising dopaminergic neurons in the ventral midbrain that project to the dorsolateral striatum, is essential for motor control and selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's disease. How this circuit assembles during human development remains poorly understood, and in vitro models capturing its long-range connectivity and spatial organization have been lacking. Here, we establish a compartmentalized, human stem cell-based model of the nigrostriatal pathway by integrating ventral midbrain and striatal organoids within a custom-engineered microfluidic device that confines cell bodies while guiding axonal growth to recapitulate key aspects of in vivo topography. Functional connectivity was confirmed by retrograde rabies tracing, and optogenetic and pharmacological stimulation. Single-nucleus transcriptomic analysis reveals that axonal target engagement with spatially separated striatal neurons promotes maturation of human dopaminergic neurons and activates transcriptional programs associated with neurotransmitter secretion. Our study establishes a biologically relevant in vitro system for investigating how long-range connectivity regulates neuronal assembly in the nigrostriatal circuit and for modelling key pathological features of Parkinson's disease.

papers.title: Rabies Post-Exposure Prophylaxis Referral Program - Impact of Expanded Vaccine Access on Immunization Rates.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Completion of rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (rPEP) remains suboptimal due to vaccine access variables and barriers during follow-up. This study evaluated whether community pharmacy referral improves rPEP series completion as compared to emergency department availability alone. METHODS: A hospital improvement plan was implemented across a 16-emergency department (ED) health system. Patients initiating rPEP in the ED with revised electronic medical record (EMR) guidance were referred to a newly formed network of community pharmacies for rPEP series completion. Completion rates before and after implementation were compared, and logistic regression identified predictors of series completion. RESULTS: During the intervention period, 367 patients initiated rPEP. Patients who chose at least one vaccine dose in a community pharmacy had higher completion rates than ED-only patients (80.0% vs 49.7%) RR 1.6; 95% CI, 1.3-2.0. rPEP patients who utilized a community pharmacy were 3.036 times (aOR=3.036; 95% CI= (1.172 - 7.861)) more likely to finish the entire series compared to those who did not utilize a community pharmacy. CONCLUSIONS: Community pharmacy is a viable resource to expand rPEP vaccine access and improve vaccine series completion as compared to emergency department visits alone.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决由于 疫苗 访问变量和后续障碍而导致 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (rPEP) 的次优完成问题。该研究的重点是评估通过社区药房扩大 疫苗 的使用范围对免疫率的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在拥有 16 个急诊科 (ED) 的医疗系统中实施了一项医院改进计划。在急诊室开始 rPEP 的患者被转诊至新成立的社区药房网络以完成系列治疗。该研究比较了实施前后的完成率。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用修订后的电子病历(EMR)指导系统将患者转诊至社区药房。使用逻辑回归比较完成率,以确定系列完成的预测因素。
elements_zh.main_results: During the intervention period, 367 patients initiated rPEP. Patients who chose at least one vaccine dose in a community pharmacy had higher completion rates than ED-only patients (80.0% vs 49.7%) with a relative risk of 1.6 (95% CI, 1.3-2.0).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,与单独急诊室的可用性相比,社区药房转诊可显着提高 rPEP 系列的完成率。这种方法提供了一种增强 疫苗 访问和遵守的新颖策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果对于通过扩展 疫苗 访问来提高 狂犬病 暴露后预防 完成率具有重要意义。这可以通过确保更有效的暴露后预防来改善公共卫生结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子病历数据的依赖以及患者转诊实践中的潜在偏差而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于单一卫生系统的实施,可能无法推广到其他环境。

analysis_en.methods: The study utilized a revised electronic medical record (EMR) guidance system to refer patients to community pharmacies. Completion rates were compared using logistic regression to identify predictors of series completion.
analysis_en.main_results: During the intervention period, 367 patients initiated rPEP. Patients who chose at least one vaccine dose in a community pharmacy had higher completion rates than ED-only patients (80.0% vs 49.7%) with a relative risk of 1.6 (95% CI, 1.3-2.0).

papers.title_zh: 狂犬病 暴露后预防 推荐计划 - 扩大 疫苗 访问范围对免疫率的影响。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Completion of rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (rPEP) remains suboptimal due to vaccine access variables and barriers during follow-up. This study evaluated whether community pharmacy referral improves rPEP series completion as compared to emergency department availability alone. METHODS: A hospital improvement plan was implemented across a 16-emergency department (ED) health system. Patients initiating rPEP in the ED with revised electronic medical record (EMR) guidance were referred to a newly formed network of community pharmacies for rPEP series completion. Completion rates before and after implementation were compared, and logistic regression identified predictors of series completion. RESULTS: During the intervention period, 367 patients initiated rPEP. Patients who chose at least one vaccine dose in a community pharmacy had higher completion rates than ED-only patients (80.0% vs 49.7%) RR 1.6; 95% CI, 1.3-2.0. rPEP patients who utilized a community pharmacy were 3.036 times (aOR=3.036; 95% CI= (1.172 - 7.861)) more likely to finish the entire series compared to those who did not utilize a community pharmacy. CONCLUSIONS: Community pharmacy is a viable resource to expand rPEP vaccine access and improve vaccine series completion as compared to emergency department visits alone.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:由于狂犬病 暴露后预防(rPEP)在随访期间存在疫苗获取变量和障碍,rPEP的完成率仍不理想。本研究评估了社区药店转介是否能比仅依靠急诊科提供更优的rPEP系列完成率。方法:在一个拥有16个急诊科(ED)的医院系统中实施了医院改进计划。在急诊科启动rPEP的患者根据修订后的电子病历(EMR)指导被转介至新建立的社区药店网络以完成rPEP系列。比较了实施前后的完成率,并通过逻辑回归分析确定了系列完成的预测因素。结果:在干预期间,共有367名患者启动了rPEP。选择在社区药店至少服用一次疫苗剂量的患者完成率高于仅在急诊科接受治疗的患者(80.0% vs 49.7%),相对风险(RR)为1.6;95%置信区间(CI)为1.3-2.0。使用社区药店的rPEP患者比未使用社区药店的患者完成整个系列的可能性高出3.036倍(aOR=3.036;95% CI= (1.172 - 7.861))。结论:与仅依靠急诊科访问相比,社区药店是扩展rPEP 疫苗获取和提高疫苗系列完成率的可行资源。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决由于 疫苗 访问变量和后续障碍而导致 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (rPEP) 的次优完成问题。该研究的重点是评估通过社区药房扩大 疫苗 的使用范围对免疫率的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在拥有 16 个急诊科 (ED) 的医疗系统中实施了一项医院改进计划。在急诊室开始 rPEP 的患者被转诊至新成立的社区药房网络以完成系列治疗。该研究比较了实施前后的完成率。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究利用修订后的电子病历(EMR)指导系统将患者转诊至社区药房。使用逻辑回归比较完成率,以确定系列完成的预测因素。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,与单独急诊室的可用性相比,社区药房转诊可显着提高 rPEP 系列的完成率。这种方法提供了一种增强 疫苗 访问和遵守的新颖策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果对于通过扩展 疫苗 访问来提高 狂犬病 暴露后预防 完成率具有重要意义。这可以通过确保更有效的暴露后预防来改善公共卫生结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对电子病历数据的依赖以及患者转诊实践中的潜在偏差而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于单一卫生系统的实施,可能无法推广到其他环境。

papers.title: From a suspected rabies death to definitive diagnosis: the crucial role of forensic medicine in a rural setting
papers.abstract: This case report highlights a rabies mortality confirmed through post- mortem analysis in a 43-year-old man in a rural area of Himachal Pradesh, India. The deceased didn’t seek post-exposure prophylaxis following a dog scratch, on his right hand, which was ignored by him. The post- mortem analysis included different diagnostic tests for confirming rabies along with histopathology investigation. The case demonstrates a unique and critical convergence of forensic medicine and disease prevention, as the confirmed post-mortem diagnosis led to the timely public health action in terms of mass animal immunization. This particular case also highlights the importance of timely access to anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) and public health education in terms of information, education and communication (IEC). Concurrently, it signifies the critical medico-legal role of forensic medicine in facilitating the deceased's underprivileged family's eligibility for financial compensation under the ongoing government scheme for accidental deaths.
papers.journal: International Journal Of Community Medicine And Public Health

papers.title_zh: 从疑似死亡 狂犬病 到最终死亡 诊断:法医学在农村环境中的关键作用
papers.source_body_en: This case report highlights a rabies mortality confirmed through post- mortem analysis in a 43-year-old man in a rural area of Himachal Pradesh, India. The deceased didn’t seek post-exposure prophylaxis following a dog scratch, on his right hand, which was ignored by him. The post- mortem analysis included different diagnostic tests for confirming rabies along with histopathology investigation. The case demonstrates a unique and critical convergence of forensic medicine and disease prevention, as the confirmed post-mortem diagnosis led to the timely public health action in terms of mass animal immunization. This particular case also highlights the importance of timely access to anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) and public health education in terms of information, education and communication (IEC). Concurrently, it signifies the critical medico-legal role of forensic medicine in facilitating the deceased's underprivileged family's eligibility for financial compensation under the ongoing government scheme for accidental deaths.
papers.abstract_zh: 该 病例报告 重点介绍了通过对印度喜马偕尔邦农村地区一名 43 岁男子的尸检分析证实的 狂犬病 死亡率。死者右手被狗抓伤后没有寻求暴露后预防,但他没有理睬。尸检分析包括用于确认 狂犬病 的不同诊断测试以及组织病理学研究。该案例展示了法医学和疾病预防的独特而重要的融合,因为确认的尸检 诊断 导致了在大规模动物免疫方面及时采取的公共卫生行动。这一特殊案例还凸显了及时获得抗 狂犬病 疫苗 (ARV) 和信息、教育和传播 (IEC) 方面的公共卫生教育的重要性。同时,它也表明法医学在促进死者贫困家庭根据现行政府意外死亡计划获得经济赔偿的资格方面发挥着重要的法医学作用。

papers.title: Where are rabies cases lost along the surveillance pathway? A comparative evaluation of participatory and passive rabies surveillance in urban Lilongwe, Malawi
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Rabies remains under-ascertained in many endemic settings, from limited effective surveillance and timely public health interventions, particularly in low-resource countries. Participatory surveillance has the potential to improve case detection, but evidence of its effect on surveillance attrition, case ascertainment, and public health decision-making remains limited. We evaluated a participatory rabies surveillance programme implemented in urban Lilongwe, Malawi, during a six-month pilot (January–June 2020). Methods Programme records from the pilot were retrospectively analysed. Surveillance progression was tracked from reporting through traceability assessment, investigation, and final case classification. Case retention, case ascertainment, and diagnostic yield were compared between participatory and passive surveillance pathways. Historical rabies diagnostic records from corresponding January–June periods during 2015–2019 served as a comparator. Results Of 610 suspected rabies reports, 393 (64.4%) were lost before traceability could be established. Of the 217 traceable reports, a further 67 (30.9%) did not progress from traceability assessment to investigation and final classification. Overall, only 150 reports (24.6%) completed the surveillance pathway. Participatory surveillance retained all reports through classification compared with 104 of 564 (18.4%) passive reports ( p < 0.001). Among classified events, confirmed or probable rabies accounted for 13 of 46 (28.3%) participatory reports compared with 7 of 104 (6.7%) passive reports (OR 5.39, 95% CI 1.82–17.39; p = 0.001). Participatory surveillance identified 13 of 20 (65.0%) confirmed or probable rabies cases, including all nine laboratory-confirmed cases detected during the study period. Compared with historical routine surveillance, participatory surveillance was associated with a 2.4-fold increase in laboratory-confirmed rabies detection and a 4.8-fold increase in overall case ascertainment. Among investigated bite exposures, 136 of 141 (96.5%) initiated post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), although only 16 (11.8%) were linked to confirmed or probable rabies exposures. Conclusion Rabies cases were lost predominantly between initial reporting and traceability assessment, with further attrition before investigation and final classification. Participatory surveillance reduced surveillance losses, improved case ascertainment, and generated more timely animal health evidence to support One Health public health decision-making, including more appropriate PEP use.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Rabies remains under-ascertained in many endemic settings, from limited effective surveillance and timely public health interventions, particularly in low-resource countries. Participatory surveillance has the potential to improve case detection, but evidence of its effect on surveillance attrition, case ascertainment, and public health decision-making remains limited. We evaluated a participatory rabies surveillance programme implemented in urban Lilongwe, Malawi, during a six-month pilot (January–June 2020). Methods Programme records from the pilot were retrospectively analysed. Surveillance progression was tracked from reporting through traceability assessment, investigation, and final case classification. Case retention, case ascertainment, and diagnostic yield were compared between participatory and passive surveillance pathways. Historical rabies diagnostic records from corresponding January–June periods during 2015–2019 served as a comparator. Results Of 610 suspected rabies reports, 393 (64.4%) were lost before traceability could be established. Of the 217 traceable reports, a further 67 (30.9%) did not progress from traceability assessment to investigation and final classification. Overall, only 150 reports (24.6%) completed the surveillance pathway. Participatory surveillance retained all reports through classification compared with 104 of 564 (18.4%) passive reports ( p < 0.001). Among classified events, confirmed or probable rabies accounted for 13 of 46 (28.3%) participatory reports compared with 7 of 104 (6.7%) passive reports (OR 5.39, 95% CI 1.82–17.39; p = 0.001). Participatory surveillance identified 13 of 20 (65.0%) confirmed or probable rabies cases, including all nine laboratory-confirmed cases detected during the study period. Compared with historical routine surveillance, participatory surveillance was associated with a 2.4-fold increase in laboratory-confirmed rabies detection and a 4.8-fold increase in overall case ascertainment. Among investigated bite exposures, 136 of 141 (96.5%) initiated post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), although only 16 (11.8%) were linked to confirmed or probable rabies exposures. Conclusion Rabies cases were lost predominantly between initial reporting and traceability assessment, with further attrition before investigation and final classification. Participatory surveillance reduced surveillance losses, improved case ascertainment, and generated more timely animal health evidence to support One Health public health decision-making, including more appropriate PEP use.

papers.title: Rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the US during 2024. Methods Animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories are collected by the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) each month. Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV). Results In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023. Of positive samples, 331 (8.6%) were domestic animals, and 3,503 (91.4%) were wildlife. The most commonly found rabid domestic animal was cats (243 positive [1.3% positivity]), and the most commonly found wildlife were bats (1,376 positive [5.7% positivity]) followed by raccoons (1,080 [10.1% positivity]). Two nonenzootic RVVs gained entry into the US in 2024. Four people died from rabies, including 2 who experienced bat exposures that were left untreated and 1 person whose case involved international travel. Conclusions The expansion of the historical range of enzootic RVVs can lead to substantial public health and animal health burden. Domestically acquired human rabies cases in 2024 underscore the need for continual public education on the risks of rabies exposures to ensure timely and effective administration of postexposure prophylaxis. The internationally acquired human rabies case demonstrates that the US remains vulnerable to human and animal rabies importations. Clinical Relevance The NRSS plays a crucial role in protecting public and animal health by monitoring rabies trends in the US.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the United States during 2024, addressing the need for understanding rabies trends and their public health implications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed data from the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS), which collects animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories each month.
analysis.methods: Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV), with results aggregated from the NRSS.
analysis.main_results: In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the increasing prevalence of animal rabies in the US, with a notable rise in cases compared to the previous year.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results emphasize the importance of ongoing rabies surveillance and public education to mitigate the risks of rabies exposure and ensure timely postexposure prophylaxis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to data collected by the NRSS, which may not capture all rabies cases, and the evidence is based on reported data, which could be subject to underreporting or variability in testing practices.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024, highlighting the epidemiologic landscape and trends in animal rabies cases. The National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) collected data from approximately 130 laboratories, reporting 3,834 rabies cases from 90,343 samples, a 2.0% increase from 2023. The most common rabid domestic animals were cats, and the most common wildlife were bats and raccoons. The study underscores the need for public education on rabies risks to ensure timely postexposure prophylaxis, as four human deaths were reported, including two from untreated bat exposures and one from an international travel-related case. The findings suggest that the expansion of enzootic rabies virus variants poses a public health and animal health burden, emphasizing the role of the NRSS in monitoring rabies trends. However, the study is limited to data from the NRSS, which may not fully represent all rabies cases due to potential underreporting or testing inconsistencies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 描述 2024 年美国 狂犬病 和 狂犬病 检测的流行病学情况。方法 美国国家 狂犬病 狂犬病 系统 (NRSS) 每月收集约 130 个公共卫生、农业和学术实验室的动物 狂犬病 检测结果。对 2024 年报告的数据进行了分析,以检查 狂犬病 变体 (RVV) 动物 狂犬病 病例的时间和地理趋势。结果 2024 年,NRSS 共报告动物 狂犬病 病例 3,834 例(占提交的 90,343 份样本的 4.2%),比 2023 年增加 2.0%。阳性样本中,家畜 331 例(8.6%),野生动物 3,503 例(91.4%)。最常见的患有狂犬病的家畜是猫(243 例阳性[1.3% 阳性率]),最常见的野生动物是蝙蝠(1,376 例阳性[5.7% 阳性率]),其次是浣熊(1,080 例[10.1% 阳性率])。2024 年,两辆非地方性 RVV 进入美国。四人死于 狂犬病,其中 2 人曾接触过蝙蝠但未得到治疗,还有 1 人的病例涉及国际旅行。结论 地方性 RVV 历史范围的扩大可能导致巨大的公共卫生和动物健康负担。2024 年国内获得的人类 狂犬病 病例强调需要持续进行有关 狂犬病 暴露风险的公众教育,以确保及时有效地实施暴露后预防。国际上获得的人类 狂犬病 病例表明,美国仍然容易受到人类和动物 狂犬病 进口的影响。临床相关性 NRSS 通过监测美国的 狂犬病 趋势,在保护公众和动物健康方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

papers.title: Serological response to extralabel use of parenteral rabies vaccines in 28 mammalian species
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To evaluate immunogenicity, persistence of antibodies, survival after challenge, and anamnestic response following extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination across mammalian species compared with benchmarks from on-label canine vaccination. Methods Mammals described in published studies of extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. A structured literature review (1980 to 2025) identified studies reporting serologic or challenge outcomes after extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. Extracted data included taxonomic family; vaccine type and schedule, timing of serum collection, antibody titers, survival after experimental challenge, and response to booster vaccination. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted by family and overall. Pooled proportions were compared with the World Organisation for Animal Health benchmark of 88% survival and with canine benchmarks for primary seroconversion (88.1%), antibody levels 6 to 12 months after primary vaccination (72.9%), and booster response (96.8%). Results 32 articles describing 41 studies met inclusion criteria, representing 2,630 animals from 28 species in 17 families. After primary vaccination, 84.4 ± 4.1% achieved titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, with 14 of 16 families noninferior to the canine benchmark. At ≥ 6 months, 63.7 ± 10.6% maintained titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL. Among 79 vaccinated animals challenged with rabies virus, 89.0 ± 9.8% survived. Booster vaccination produced adequate titers in 89.1 ± 8.0% of 275 animals, with reduced responses in the families Elephantidae and Ursidae. Conclusions Modern-day rabies vaccines generate strong antibody responses across diverse mammalian families, with nondomestic canids responding similarly to domestic dogs. Clinical Relevance These findings support recognizing extralabel vaccination as biologically protective and can inform public health and animal management policies.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述评估了哺乳动物物种中标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后的免疫原性、抗体的持久性、攻击后的存活率以及记忆反应,并与标签上的犬类 疫苗接种 的基准进行了比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 一项结构化文献综述(1980 年至 2025 年)确定了报告标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后血清学或挑战结果的研究。提取的数据包括分类科;疫苗 类型和时间表、血清采集时间、抗体滴度、实验攻击后的存活率以及对加强剂 疫苗接种 的反应。按家庭和整体进行随机效应荟萃分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 初次 疫苗接种 后,84.4 ± 4.1% 的家系达到滴度 ≥ 0.5 IU/mL,其中 16 个家系中有 14 个家系不劣于犬类基准。≥ 6 个月时,63.7 ± 10.6% 的滴度维持≥ 0.5 IU/mL。在接受 狂犬病病毒 攻击的 79 只接种疫苗的动物中,89.0 ± 9.8% 存活。加强剂 疫苗接种 在 275 只动物中的 89.1 ± 8.0% 中产生了足够的滴度,但象科和熊科的反应有所降低。现代 狂犬病 疫苗 在不同的哺乳动物家族中产生强烈的抗体反应,非家养犬科动物的反应与家养狗类似。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述未报告与 狂犬病病毒 相关的具体争议或证据差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现支持将额外标签 疫苗接种 视为生物保护性的,并且可以为公共卫生和动物管理政策提供信息。

papers.title: Epidemiology of dog bite injuries in the Volta Region, Ghana: A retrospective analysis
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dog bite injury is a public health concern in Ghana due to its potential to cause the deadly rabies disease in humans. To understand the dog bite injury situation in the Volta Region and inform preventive and control measures, this study described the incidence, trend and distribution of dog bite injuries in the Volta Region of Ghana from 2019 to 2023. Methods: A retrospective cross-sectional study on dog bite injuries was conducted in the Volta Region of Ghana using dog bite injury and mortality data from the District Health Information Management System 2 (DHIMS2) and the District Health Information System (DHIS) from 2019 to 2023. We analyzed the data using Stata version 17 and Quantum Geographic Information Systems (QGIS) 3.30. We generated frequencies, proportions, ratios, and choropleth maps. We used Poisson regression to estimate crude incidence rate ratios and their 95% confidence intervals. The results were presented as tables, graphs and maps. Results: Of the 3,619 dog bite cases reported from 2019 to 2023, four were fatal. The overall incidence of dog bite injury was 41.9 per 100,000 population and a mortality rate of 0.05 per 100,000. Females were less likely to experience a dog bite compared to males (IRR = 0.82; 95% CI: 0.77–0.88). Compared to children aged 0–4 years, those aged 5–9 years had a higher risk of dog bite injury (IRR = 1.46; 95% CI: 1.30–1.65). The incidence rate reduced from 48.4 in 2021 to 39.2 per 100,000 in 2023. Hohoe and Keta Municipalities recorded the highest yearly incidence rate, while Akatsi North District recorded the lowest rate. Conclusion: The incidence of dog bite injuries in the Volta Region was 41.9 per 100,000 population. Males had a higher reported incidence than females, and children aged 5–9 years had the highest age-specific incidence. Hohoe and Keta Municipalities recorded the highest incidence rates. These findings supported the need for targeted school- and community-based dog bite prevention education, responsible dog ownership, and strengthened surveillance.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用回顾性横断面研究方法,利用加纳沃尔塔地区2019年至2023年期间District Health Information Management System 2(DHIMS2)和District Health Information System(DHIS)的数据。

papers.title: Microbiological safety assessment of canine adipose derived mesenchymal stem cell preparations reveal no detectable contamination
papers.abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.
